data.name: Parfait Crane
data.detailed_description:
Parfait Crane is a physics-based 3D fruit stacking arcade game where you drop fruits with a crane, merge matching Parfait Crane is a physics-based 3D fruit merging arcade game where you control a crane, drop fruits into a parfait cup, and aim for the highest score through efficient merges.

The goal is not simply to build a tall tower. Your objective is to combine fruits through 11 stages, create larger fruits, trigger explosive chain reactions, and push your score as high as possible before the parfait collapses.

Each fruit drop changes the entire situation. Fruits roll, slide, collide, bounce, and settle through physics. A careful drop can create a stable setup, while one unexpected movement can trigger a massive merge chain.

Merge two matching fruits to create the next fruit stage and earn points. The higher the fruit stage, the greater the reward. Plan your drops, manage the limited space, and look for opportunities to set up satisfying chain reactions.

Key Features

11-Stage Fruit Merging

Combine matching fruits through 11 fruit stages and aim for higher-scoring merges.

Explosive Chain Reactions

One good drop can trigger a burst of consecutive merges, creating the most satisfying moments in the game.

Score Attack Gameplay

The main goal is to earn the highest score possible through efficient placement, smart timing, and lucky physics.

Crane-Based Controls

Move the crane, choose your drop position, and release each fruit at the right moment.

Signalman Shake

Use the Signalman role to shake the fruits and create unexpected movement. A well-timed shake can rescue a bad situation, disturb the stack, or help trigger a powerful chain reaction.

Physics-Based Uncertainty

Fruits do not always behave exactly as planned. They roll, collide, settle, and sometimes betray your expectations.

Cute but Dangerous

The game looks sweet, but one unstable drop or one risky shake can turn your parfait into a collapsing mess.

Steam Leaderboards

Compete for high scores and see how your best run compares with other players.

data.short_description: Parfait Crane is a physics-based 3D fruit stacking arcade game. Drop, merge, and stack fruits with a crane, chase high scores, and try not to let your parfait collapse.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Window 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows compatible audio device
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows compatible audio device
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended.
